architecture_recommendations: Keep Nexus Core planner/selector deterministic and data-driven; external catalogs remain untrusted candidate sources.
Introduce a separate Candidate Admission Control Plane with immutable source identity, commit/package hash, license, scanner evidence, duplicate disposition, compatibility and reviewer decision.

Use an explicit state ladder: DISCOVERED -> VERIFIED -> DEEPLY_EVALUATED -> QUARANTINED/APPROVED_REFERENCE -> ELIGIBLE_FOR_ROUTING; execution requires an independent Host mapping and current-turn evidence.
Build a minimal append-only local task/event ledger before Agent Runtime or self-healing. Every side effect needs an idempotency key and validation receipt.
Use deterministic validators as the primary quality gate. LLM judges are supplemental, calibrated, versioned and never sole authority.
Adopt protocol-specific adapters: Agent Skills for instruction packages, MCP Registry/MCP for tools, ACP for editor-agent capability negotiation, and A2A only after Agent Runtime exists.

For memory, build a Nexus-owned narrow model combining typed assets, temporal provenance, bounded retrieval, namespace permissions, retention/forgetting and human promotion. Do not import Tencent's proxy.
For code intelligence, layer pinned Tree-sitter parsing and SCIP-like indexes before considering a turnkey graph runtime.
Keep telemetry opt-in, local-first and redacted. Never auto-capture prompts, Skill bodies, project rules, absolute paths, secrets or hidden reasoning.
No candidate may install, update, start a process, mutate host configuration or become executable because of discovery metadata or popularity.
